posts.subject: DooDoo on other side
posts.bodyHtml: I know that I was not playing on this server long but player called "CoCo" was racist towards me and I have people to back me up, so I decieded to message DooDoo he came on the server and wanted to know what happend, but he took "CoCo's" side because he knows her longer which is unacceptable from his side and when he left he just muted me and TimeZ, I don't think doodoo has done his job right because he listend to a single voice comparing to more people that agreed with me.

I have a few reasons as to why I did that:


First of all, I was in a middle of a competitive game so I was forced to make a quick decision. I have tried contacting other admins to help me by going to the server and sorting out the issue, however, they didn't reply so I simply too action, as I admit, quite hastily.


Second of all, I decided to take the side of CoCo because of a couple of reasons:
1. I've known her for longer, I know she is trustworthy and that she is a generally nice person.
2. Knowing the nature of both you and TimeZ, which may I add that you both have previous bans due to negative behavior, I simply muted both of you to prevent any more problems in the short term.
3. Thirdly, you suggest how there was "more people that agreed with me." During my short time on the server, I saw nobody say anything that supported you, hence, caused me to yet again, slide over to CoCo's side.


In addition to that, according to my other sources, after the mute, you've been quite abusive to CoCo. I've heard from another play that said you "now he is telling her to drink bleache and kill herself."


I understand that I may be slightly at fault by taking Cornelia's side but, may I reinforce that I was made to make a quick decision. Therefore, I simply muted you (which is only for one map due to a bug - which I believe that it is not important as it is only a short term punishment).
We have just discussed the situation and I think Oxygen has more to add.

I know I have done wrong to many people on this server and I was not always a great person, but I would like to give my deepest sincere to everyone I have done wrong especially coco as she was the one that took my short temper on the max, she has showed that you can stay calm under soo heavy insults, coco I'm really sorry and hopefully you will forgive me after what I have done, as doodoo state I know I was in wrong since beginig and I want to sincere everyone of you guys and girls.

The problem has now been resolved.


/close thread?
@BlackFire@Nachtfrische @Sky

I've confirmed that the problem has been resolved and therefore will close the thread now.
The ban from Doo Doo stays since the behavior of Oxygen was inappropriate in the situation.


[closesnew*]
